subject: general
question: Mecca is located in which country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Saudi Arabia**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Mecca is located in Saudi Arabia, in the Hejaz region's Makkah province.
 
• It's the holiest city in Islam and is considered the birthplace of the Prophet Muhammad. 
 
• Mecca is 70 kilometers inland from Jeddah on the Red Sea, in a valley 277 meters above sea level. 
 
• Population
 
• In 2022, Mecca's metropolitan population was 2.4 million, making it the third-most populated city in Saudi Arabia. 
 
• Importance
 
• Mecca is the religious capital of Saudi Arabia and is home to the Kaaba, Islam's most sacred site.
 
• Millions of Muslims from around the world travel to Mecca each year to perform the Hajj, an annual pilgrimage that's one of the Five Pillars of Islam. 
 
• Economy
 
• Mecca is a major economic center in Saudi Arabia, with a thriving tourism industry and many businesses and industries
